desc_background_refresh: Choosing an image, applying its scale, or clearing it immediately saves the display settings and reloads the page. Save other pending configuration changes first.
desc_background_source: Download character PNG artwork from an information site.
notice_background_invalid_image: This image could not be read. Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, or TIFF image.
notice_background_upload_rejected: Choose a supported image format with a file size no larger than 10 MB.
notice_background_invalid_scale: Enter a valid scale between 20.0 and 200.0.
notice_background_file_error: The background image or display settings could not be saved. Check that the files are writable.
BAAH_desc: BAAH can help you complete the dailies of Blue Archive in the JP server, Global server, CN official server, Bilibili server. All config files are in the BAAH_CONFIGS folder.
desc_project_resources: The project homepages and Bilibili video tutorials are listed here. Please review them to learn how to use this project.
BAAH_get_version: To get the latest version, download from GitHub or join the group to download
BAAH_attention: Please set the emulator resolution to 1280*720, 240DPI, better close network bridge; Game settings: the skill animation off, black bars during battles off
config_cafe_attention: Zoom the cafe camera all the way out and turn off interactive furniture before a run. BAAH taps students from that view without moving the camera.
desc_cafe_invite: To invite specific students, pin the students you want to invite and set the filter in the cafe invite list to 'Pinned'
config_kill_port: Whether force to kill the port before starting emulator
config_close_emulator_and_baah: Close Emulator and BAAH After Execution
config_desc_times: About the level number, 3 means the third level, if -1 that means the last level which can be raid. About the number of times: 4 times means sweep 4 times, -1 means sweep max times, -2 means sweep max - 2 times.
confirm_delete_config_body: BAAH moves it to DATA/USER_STORAGE as .delconfig_{name}. Move it back to BAAH_CONFIGS as {name} to restore it.
tip_add_task: Add a task below this one
config_runs_never: Never runs: a month has at most 31 days
tip_column_bounty: Order on the Location Select screen: 1 = Overpass, 2 = Desert Railroad, 3 = Classroom.
tip_column_commission: Order on the Request Select screen: 1 = Base Defense, 2 = Item Retrieval.
tip_column_scrimmage: Order on the Academy Select screen: 1 = Trinity, 2 = Gehenna, 3 = Millennium.
tip_column_area: The Area number on the Mission screen, e.g. 20 for stage 20-3.
tip_column_area_stage: The stage inside the area: 3 for stage 20-3.
tip_column_event_stage: Stage number on the event's Quest tab.
tip_column_stage: -1 = the last stage you can sweep, -2 = the one before it.
tip_column_times: Sweeps per run. -1 = Max (the sweep popup's Max button), 0 = skip.
config_no_tasks_set_here: No tasks are configured for this day. This task will be skipped when the script runs on that day.
config_desc_list_edit: BAAH runs one day's list each day and cycles through them. Keep one day to do the same thing every day. Each card shows the dates it runs.
config_desc_timetable: The 'Location' refers to the different tabs on the right side of the Lesson (e.g., Schale Office, Schale Residence Hall, etc.). The 'Room' refers to the rooms in each academy in the Lesson, counted from left to right and top to bottom, numbered from 1 to 9. If a room is not set to be clicked in a certain area, that area will be skipped.
tip_shop_normal_refresh: How many times BAAH refreshes this shop to buy more. Each refresh costs Pyroxene.
tip_shop_contest_refresh: How many times BAAH refreshes this shop to buy more. Each refresh costs Tactical Challenge Coins.
config_desc_shop_edit: The row number refers to the row of the right-hand side items in the normal shop, and the column refers to the four items from left to right in that row. If you don't want to buy items in a certain row, just leave that row empty.
config_desc_next_config: If you want to execute other configuration files after completing the current one, you can add them here. If not needed, it can be left blank
config_warn_change: Note: The following settings are NOT recommended to change unless you know what you are doing
config_desc_response_y: If sliding too far, adjust this item smaller 60->40, if not far enough adjust larger 40->60
config_rainbow_teams_desc: Auto select team according to the attribute, if not checked, you need to manually configure the team each time
config_explore_attention: Better define the team strength of each team
get_email_pwd: How to get Email SMTP token
notice_example_json: You are using the example json file, please rename it before editing and restart GUI
cafe_invite_desc: cafe invite which student (0 means no invite)
tip_cafe_invite_seq: The student's place in the MomoTalk invite list, counting from the top. 0 = don't invite.
raise_error_if_can_not_push_event_level: Fail the run if an event stage can't be 3-starred
desc_grand_assault_no_fight: Sweep only (skip areas that need a fight)
adb_disable_auto_disconnect: Disable ADB auto-disconnect, suitable for physical devices/Shizuku/AVD
config_api_noti_body_desc: Enter valid JSON. Use [token], [title], and [content] placeholders in strings.
tip_smart_timetable: On: BAAH reads every room and picks the best one by the weights below. Off: it follows your fixed list of rooms.
tip_timetable_weight_reward: How much better rewards count when BAAH picks a room. Higher = counts for more.
tip_timetable_weight_heart: How much a room's affection hearts count. Higher = counts for more.
tip_timetable_weight_lock: How much unlocking new rooms counts. Higher = counts for more.
config_buy_ap_attention: When buying AP, please make sure you have enough Pyroxene
config_buy_ap_rules_notice: If you add one or more Buy AP tasks to your daily pipeline, the rules below will be evaluated once for each such task whenever the script runs to decide whether to buy AP. Avoid setting the maximum price too high to prevent unintended purchases.
tip_buy_ap_max_price: The game's Unit Cost rises with each purchase in a day. BAAH stops buying once it is above this.
config_buy_ap_add_times: AP packs per purchase (120 AP each)
tip_buy_ap_add_times: BAAH presses + until this many packs are picked, then buys once. 2 = 240 AP.
config_pre_command: Command before task start, leave blank to ignore
config_post_command: Command after task end, leave blank to ignore
config_craft_desc: Normal craft task will choose the first yellow node
config_login_timeout: Set timeout for logging in to the game (seconds)
config_max_emulator_restart_times: Max emulator restart times when login timeout
desc_team_strength: Define the type of attack of each team, 0 to 10. No need to consider the effective against. For example, if first team has half Piercing attack and half Explosive attack, then just set the number of Piercing and Explosive to 5.
config_cafe_samename_defer: If that student is already in the cafe, invite the next one down
config_desc_quick_call_task: Run a single task right now, without starting your whole pipeline. The push (Explore) tasks also need a start chapter and stage which are set on Explore Configuration.
config_desc_setting_emulator:
Decide what BAAH closes when a run ends (the emulator, the game or BAAH itself), how long to wait for the game to log in, and how many times to restart the emulator if login stalls.

The server, ADB port and emulator path are handled in the bar at the top.
config_desc_setting_other: Settings for BAAH itself: editor background, log files, error reports, wait and retry timing, swipe distance and screenshot mode. Only change these if something misbehaves.
config_desc_setting_crash_report_manager:
When a run fails and error reports are on, BAAH saves a folder of logs, screenshots and a copy of your config here. Download it as a zip to attach to a bug report.

Note: Email and API token are in plaintext in userconfig.json.
config_desc_setting_task_order: Choose which tasks run and in what order. A run works through the active pipeline from top to bottom. You can keep several pipelines and switch between them, and run a command before or after.
config_desc_setting_vpn: If you need a VPN app to reach the game, list the steps BAAH takes to turn it on before a run and off afterwards, such as opening the app and tapping its connect button.
config_desc_setting_notification: Get a message when a run finishes or hits an error, by email or through a push service such as PushPlus, ServerChan or Telegram.
config_desc_task_login_game: BAAH opens the game and taps through to the lobby on its own. If your account stops on an extra screen while logging in, turn this on and add the taps it needs.
config_desc_task_cafe:
Collects the cafe's earnings, taps students for affection and use invitations.

Note: Recommended to zoom the cafe camera out all the way first so BAAH can find everyone.
config_desc_task_timetable: Spends your lesson tickets. Turn on room recognition to let BAAH pick rooms by the rewards, affection and room unlocks you value most, or pick the rooms yourself.
config_desc_task_craft: Collects finished crafts and starts new ones, up to the number you set. Turn on Quick Craft to use the game's Quick Craft option instead.
config_desc_task_shop: Buys the items you pick from the Normal shop and the Tactical Challenge shop, and can refresh each shop a set number of times.
config_desc_task_buy_ap: Buys AP with Pyroxene, but only while the price is at or below your limit.
config_desc_task_exam: Takes on the Joint Firing Drill at the stage you choose with as many teams as you set, and can drop to an easier level if a run fails.
config_desc_task_assault: Fights or sweeps the current Total Assault boss at your target difficulty, and unlocks that difficulty first if it is still locked.
config_desc_task_grand_assault: Sweeps each Grand Assault area at the difficulty you set. If that difficulty is not cleared yet, BAAH tries the game's auto-battle, unless you choose sweep only.
config_desc_task_oneclick_raid:
Runs the game's Multi-Sweep on the Mission screen. In the game, open Multi-Sweep, tick the stages you want on tabs 1-7 and press Save. BAAH does not pick the stages for you.

Each row picks a tab (1-7) and how many times to sweep every ticked stage on it. -1 presses MAX, limited by your AP and the Hard 3/day limit. With more than one Day list, BAAH uses a different one each day.
config_desc_task_user_def_task: Your own task running in the pipeline. Build it from actions such as taps, waits and opening apps, or turn action flow mode off to write Python code instead.
config_desc_setting_explore: Settings for the Explore buttons on the Quick Call Task page, which clear story stages you haven't done yet. Choose how teams are picked (the game's Auto Formation, or BAAH matching your saved teams by attack type), and which Normal and Hard stage to start clearing from.
config_desc_task_wanted: Sweeps the Bounty stages you list below with your Bounty tickets.
config_desc_task_special: Sweeps the Commission stages you list below, for credits and EXP reports.
config_desc_task_exchange: Sweeps the Scrimmage stages you list below with your Scrimmage tickets.
config_desc_task_event: Sweeps the stages you list below in the event that is running now.
config_desc_task_hard: Sweeps the Hard stages you list below, usually to farm a student's Eleph.
config_desc_task_normal: Sweeps the Normal stages you list below, usually to farm gear.
tip_use_quick_craft: Uses the game's Quick Craft button, which picks the nodes for you. Off: BAAH picks the first yellow node itself.
config_output_err_log: Save a log when an error occurs
config_shop_contest_buyall: Buy all in Tactical Challenge Shop
desc_one_click_raid: One click raid, need to select the raid stage first and manually raid once to save the selection. The number of task is the page number after clicking one click raid, and the number of times is how many times to raid on that page.
desc_cli_since_manual: Since the explore task is set to manual start up teams, run in GUI will report an error， please use terminal to run
tip_exam_times: Each team runs the stage once, in order, whether or not an earlier team cleared it. A team that fails drops a stage only if the box below is on.
desc_exam_allow_fallback: If the drill fails, try the stage below
desc_noti_content_diy: Customize the email content formatting string by wrapping desired fields with %KEY%. You can view available fields in the project's modules/configs/defaultSettings.
desc_noti_content_diy_hint: By default, notifications contain workflow and schedule reminders. You can customize the notification format string to change the message that is sent.
error_if_assault_no_team: Stop the whole run if no team can fight
tip_assault_no_team: On: the run stops here and the error notification is sent. Off: BAAH skips Total Assault and moves on to the next task.
tip_assault_helper: BAAH borrows the assistant for the first fight only. If it can't find the student, it fights without one.
tip_assault_locked: If this difficulty is still locked, BAAH clears the lower ones first to unlock it. BAAH uses the game's auto battle, which plays weaker than you do, so a difficulty a step or two below what you clear by hand is safer.
tip_grand_assault_fight: If an area isn't cleared at this difficulty, BAAH fights it with the game's auto battle. Auto plays weaker than you do, so a difficulty a step or two below what you clear by hand is safer.
error_if_grand_assault_no_team: Stop the whole run if no team can fight
tip_grand_assault_no_fight: BAAH sweeps the areas you have already cleared at this difficulty and skips the rest instead of fighting.
tip_grand_assault_no_team: On: the run stops here and the error notification is sent. Off: BAAH skips that area and moves on to the next one.
desc_flow_when_login_game: Execute the following custom actions on the account login page
desc_rerun_when_script_error: Number of times to rerun the current config file when script error occurs
desc_rerun_start_from_lastpoint: Resume from the task that failed
config_timetable_special_student_pic_des: To add the students you want to prioritize in the timetable, please take a screenshot of the student avatars in the pop-up window of the classroom nine-grid in the timetable (note that only the content of the avatar is needed). Each student is with a weight of 1000.
config_event_roll_enter_desc: Please take a screenshot of the button in the lower left corner of the event page that leads to the lottery page. Try to capture only the button itself, as BAAH will look for this image on the event page to click and enter the lottery page.
config_event_exchange_enter_desc: Please capture the image of the [Gift Exchange] button located at the bottom-left corner of the event page below. Include only the button area as much as possible. BAAH will search for this image on the event page and click it to enter the [Gift Exchange] page.
config_pipelines_desc: You can configure multiple pipelines, but only one can be active at a time and must be switched manually.
config_try_enter_event_number: Number of attempts to enter the event page
config_event_status: Execute only when the event is active
notice_QA: How to use and FAQ, view the official website
mirror_desc: You can add an existing Mirror key to speed up the download of update packages and improve stability
notice_steam_esc_break: Close the button mention, Long press esc to interrupt script execution
aria2_thread: The number of Aria2 download threads
aria2_max_tries: Maximum number of retries for Aria2
aria2_failured_wait_time: Wait time after Aria2 download failure
config_big_update: Update the game package if needed (Experimental)
big_update_type_direct_get_tips: This method relies on the server to update the URL file, and there may be a delay in server updates. Please refer to https://api.blockhaity.dpdns.org/docs/#/api-doc/baapk for details
name: Name
